risk_if_not_implemented: Without Analyze and Prioritize Monitoring Requirements, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Analysis & Triage
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure event log and security-relevant telemetry reviews include analysis and triage practices that integrate with the organization's established incident response processes.
compensating_control_1.justification: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Analysis & Triage (MON-05.2) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Analyze and Prioritize Monitoring Requirements (MON-03.2) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
